T01_salary_increase.pattern_en: Your monthly salary has increased to (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. The change applies from (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})
T01_salary_increase.pattern_id: Gaji bulanan Anda naik menjadi (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Perubahan ini berlaku mulai (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})

T02_salary_confirmed_onetime_unspecified.pattern_en: Your regular salary for the next payroll is confirmed\. Your next payslip will show the regular pay and any one-off adjustment separately
T02_salary_confirmed_onetime_unspecified.pattern_id: Gaji rutin untuk penggajian berikutnya sudah dikonfirmasi\. Slip gaji berikutnya akan menampilkan gaji rutin dan penyesuaian satu kali secara terpisah
T02_salary_confirmed_onetime_unspecified.gist: Regular salary confirmed; a one-time adjustment will appear separately but no amount is given.

T03_bonus_pending_review.pattern_en: Your quarterly bonus is still subject to the final performance review\. The final amount and payment date have not been approved yet
T03_bonus_pending_review.pattern_id: Bonus kuartalan Anda masih menunggu hasil akhir penilaian kinerja\. Jumlah akhir dan tanggal pembayaran belum disetujui
T03_bonus_pending_review.gist: Quarterly bonus not approved: amount and date unknown.

T04_temporary_reduced_pay.pattern_en: Your temporary monthly pay is (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. The reduced amount continues for the next payroll
T04_temporary_reduced_pay.pattern_id: Gaji bulanan sementara Anda adalah (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Jumlah yang lebih rendah masih berlaku untuk penggajian berikutnya
T04_temporary_reduced_pay.gist: Next payroll is a temporarily reduced amount {amount}.

T05_salary_date_change.pattern_en: Your confirmed salary is now expected on (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. This replaces the payroll date shown in the earlier update
T05_salary_date_change.pattern_id: Gaji yang sudah dikonfirmasi kini diperkirakan masuk pada (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. Tanggal ini menggantikan tanggal penggajian

T06_salary_reduced_unpaid_leave.pattern_en: Your next salary is reduced to (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. The adjustment is due to approved unpaid leave
T06_salary_reduced_unpaid_leave.pattern_id: Gaji berikutnya Anda dikurangi menjadi (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Penyesuaian ini karena cuti tanpa gaji yang disetujui
T06_salary_reduced_unpaid_leave.gist: Next salary only is reduced to {amount} (unpaid leave).

T07_base_salary_commission_pending.pattern_en: Your confirmed base salary is (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. The commission shown for open deals is still pending approval
T07_base_salary_commission_pending.pattern_id: Gaji pokok yang dikonfirmasi adalah (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Komisi dari transaksi yang masih berjalan belum disetujui
T07_base_salary_commission_pending.gist: Base salary {amount} confirmed; commission on open deals is not earned yet.

T08_seasonal_contract_ended.pattern_en: The current seasonal contract has ended\. No off-season income or renewal has been confirmed
T08_seasonal_contract_ended.pattern_id: Kontrak musiman saat ini telah berakhir\. Belum ada pendapatan di luar musim atau perpanjangan kontrak yang dikonfirmasi
T08_seasonal_contract_ended.gist: Seasonal contract ended; no further income confirmed.

T09_salary_resumes_childcare.pattern_en: Regular salary of (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) resumes on (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. A new recurring childcare payment begins in the same month
T09_salary_resumes_childcare.pattern_id: Gaji rutin sebesar (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) kembali dibayarkan pada (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. Pembayaran penitipan anak rutin yang baru dimulai pada bulan yang sama
T09_salary_resumes_childcare.gist: Salary {amount} resumes on {date} after leave; a new recurring childcare expense (amount unspecified) starts the same month.

T10_first_salary_credit_date.pattern_en: Your first salary will be (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. The confirmed credit date is (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})
T10_first_salary_credit_date.pattern_id: Gaji pertama Anda sebesar (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Tanggal kredit yang dikonfirmasi adalah (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})

T11_first_salary_new_employer.pattern_en: Your first salary from the new employer is (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. It is confirmed for (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})
T11_first_salary_new_employer.pattern_id: Gaji pertama dari perusahaan baru adalah (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Pembayaran sudah dikonfirmasi untuk (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})
T11_first_salary_new_employer.gist: First salary from new employer {amount} confirmed for {date}.

T12_first_salary_scheduled.pattern_en: Your first salary of (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) is scheduled for (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. Payroll has approved the payment
T12_first_salary_scheduled.pattern_id: Gaji pertama Anda sebesar (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) dijadwalkan pada (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. Tim payroll sudah menyetujui pembayaran
T12_first_salary_scheduled.gist: First salary {amount} approved and scheduled for {date}.

T13_foreign_salary_confirmed.pattern_en: Your salary of (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) is confirmed for (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. The receiving bank will convert it using the rate applied on the settlement date
T13_foreign_salary_confirmed.pattern_id: Gaji sebesar (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) dikonfirmasi untuk (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. Bank penerima akan mengonversinya dengan kurs pada tanggal penyelesaian
T13_foreign_salary_confirmed.gist: Foreign-currency salary {amount} confirmed for {date}; convert at the settlement-date rate.

T14_regular_plus_arrears.pattern_en: Your regular salary for the next payroll is (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. The same payroll includes a one-time arrears adjustment of (?P<currency2>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount2>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
T14_regular_plus_arrears.pattern_id: Gaji rutin Anda untuk penggajian berikutnya adalah (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Penggajian yang sama mencakup penyesuaian tunggakan satu kali sebesar (?P<currency2>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount2>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
T14_regular_plus_arrears.gist: Regular salary {amount} plus a one-time arrears credit {amount2} on the next payroll.

T15_household_income_ended.pattern_en: One household employment record has ended\. The remaining confirmed monthly salary is (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
T15_household_income_ended.pattern_id: Salah satu sumber pendapatan kerja rumah tangga telah berakhir\. Sisa gaji bulanan yang dikonfirmasi adalah (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
T15_household_income_ended.gist: One household income stream ended; remaining confirmed monthly salary is {amount}.

T16_employment_ended.pattern_en: Your employment has ended\. There are no regular salary payments scheduled after the final settlement
T16_employment_ended.pattern_id: Hubungan kerja Anda telah berakhir\. Tidak ada pembayaran gaji rutin yang dijadwalkan setelah penyelesaian akhir
T16_employment_ended.gist: Employment ended; no salary after the final settlement.

T17_reimbursement_not_salary.pattern_en: The latest employer credit is the reimbursement for your earlier work expense\. The claim is now closed
T17_reimbursement_not_salary.pattern_id: Dana terbaru dari perusahaan adalah penggantian atas biaya kerja Anda sebelumnya\. Klaim sudah ditutup
T17_reimbursement_not_salary.gist: Employer credit is a one-off expense reimbursement, not salary; do not treat as recurring.

T18_gig_payout_pending.pattern_en: The next (?P<company>[A-Za-z]+) payout is still pending\. The weekly earnings shown in the [A-Za-z]+ app can change until the payout is closed
T18_gig_payout_pending.pattern_id: Pembayaran berikutnya dari (?P<company>[A-Za-z]+) masih tertunda\. Penghasilan mingguan di aplikasi [A-Za-z]+ masih dapat berubah
T18_gig_payout_pending.gist: Gig-platform payout still pending; balance not withdrawable.

T19_rent_increase_percent.pattern_en: The renewed lease increases monthly rent by (?P<percent>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%
T19_rent_increase_percent.pattern_id: Perpanjangan sewa menaikkan biaya sewa bulanan sebesar (?P<percent>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%
T19_rent_increase_percent.gist: Monthly rent rises by {percent}% from the next rent payment.

T20_invoice_approved.pattern_en: The client approved an invoice payment of (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Settlement is expected on (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}); the other submitted invoices are still awaiting approval
T20_invoice_approved.pattern_id: Klien menyetujui pembayaran faktur sebesar (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\. Penyelesaian diperkirakan pada (?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}); faktur lain yang diajukan masih menunggu persetujuan
T20_invoice_approved.gist: One invoice {amount} approved, settling {date}; other invoices unconfirmed.

T21_receipt_confirms_settled_expense.pattern_en: (?:payment was received on|order was paid in (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) on) (?P<date_long>\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4})\. The receipt has the final (?:[A-Z]{3} )?amount
T21_receipt_confirms_settled_expense.pattern_id: (?:pembayaran diterima pada|pesanan dibayar dalam (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) pada) (?P<date_long>\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4})\. Kuitansi memuat jumlah akhir
T21_receipt_confirms_settled_expense.gist: Receipt confirms a settled expense whose amount is blank in events; read amount from the linked image.

T22_wallet_charge_plus_foreign_salary.pattern_en: Your wallet was charged for the session at .+? on (?P<date_long2>\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4}).*?The receipt contains the final [A-Z]{3} amount\. Your employer has confirmed a (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) salary credit for (?P<date_long>\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4})
T22_wallet_charge_plus_foreign_salary.pattern_id: Dompet Anda dikenakan biaya untuk sesi di .+? pada (?P<date_long2>\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4}).*?Kuitansi memuat jumlah akhir [A-Z]{3}\. Perusahaan Anda mengonfirmasi kredit gaji (?P<currency>[A-Z]{3}) (?P<amount>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) untuk (?P<date_long>\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]+ \d{4})
T22_wallet_charge_plus_foreign_salary.gist: Wallet charge confirmed (amount from image) and a foreign-currency salary {amount} confirmed for {date_long}.

T23_internal_transfer.pattern_en: The matching debit and credit came from a transfer between your two accounts
T23_internal_transfer.pattern_id: Debit dan kredit dengan jumlah yang sama berasal dari transfer antara dua rekening Anda
T23_internal_transfer.gist: Matching debit/credit pair is an own-account transfer; net zero.

T24_debit_failed_retry.pattern_en: The previous debit attempt failed\. The bill is still outstanding and another debit will be attempted
T24_debit_failed_retry.pattern_id: Upaya debit sebelumnya gagal\. Tagihan masih belum dibayar dan debit akan dicoba lagi
T24_debit_failed_retry.gist: Failed bill debit will be retried; the bill is still owed.

T25_card_dispute_open.pattern_en: The extra card charge is still being investigated\. A reversal has not been posted to the account yet
T25_card_dispute_open.pattern_id: Tagihan kartu tambahan masih dalam penyelidikan\. Dana pembalikannya belum tercatat di rekening
T25_card_dispute_open.gist: Disputed duplicate card charge; no reversal yet, so the debit still counts and no credit is assumed.

T26_two_card_minimums.pattern_en: There are minimum payments due on two separate card accounts this month\. A payment to one card will not cover the amount due on the other card
T26_two_card_minimums.pattern_id: Ada pembayaran minimum yang jatuh tempo pada dua rekening kartu terpisah bulan ini
T26_two_card_minimums.gist: Two separate card minimums are both due; do not merge them as duplicates.

T27_refund_initiated_not_received.pattern_en: Your refund has been initiated but has not reached your account yet
T27_refund_initiated_not_received.pattern_id: Pengembalian dana sudah diproses, tetapi belum masuk ke rekening Anda
T27_refund_initiated_not_received.gist: Merchant refund initiated but not credited.

T28_foreign_refund_processing.pattern_en: The foreign-currency refund is still processing\. (?:The final home-currency credit will be calculated when the refund settles\. )?The home-currency credit may change with the settlement-date rate
T28_foreign_refund_processing.pattern_id: Pengembalian dana dalam mata uang asing masih diproses
T28_foreign_refund_processing.gist: Foreign-currency refund still processing; home-currency value unknown until settlement.

T29_foreign_bill_charged.pattern_en: The bill was charged in a foreign currency\. Your bank will confirm the final home-currency amount when the transaction settles
T29_foreign_bill_charged.pattern_id: Tagihan dikenakan dalam mata uang asing\. Bank Anda akan mengonfirmasi jumlah akhir dalam mata uang utama saat transaksi selesai
T29_foreign_bill_charged.gist: A bill was charged in foreign currency; convert with the settlement-date rate (still a debit).

T30_portfolio_value_up.pattern_en: Your portfolio.s displayed market value has increased substantially
T30_portfolio_value_up.pattern_id: Nilai pasar portofolio Anda yang ditampilkan telah meningkat

T31_investment_value_down.pattern_en: The displayed value of the investment has fallen\. The holding has not been sold
T31_investment_value_down.pattern_id: Nilai investasi yang ditampilkan telah turun\. Investasi tersebut belum dijual

T32_prize_claim_processing.pattern_en: Your prize claim has been verified and is still in payment processing\. The payment has not been credited
T32_prize_claim_processing.pattern_id: Klaim hadiah Anda sudah diverifikasi dan masih dalam proses pembayaran\. Pembayaran tersebut belum masuk
T32_prize_claim_processing.gist: Prize payment verified but not credited.

T33_prize_proceeds_received.pattern_en: The prize proceeds have reached your account after withholding
T33_prize_proceeds_received.pattern_id: Hasil hadiah sudah masuk ke rekening Anda setelah pemotongan
T33_prize_proceeds_received.gist: Prize already settled; one-off, no further payments.

T34_investment_sale_settled.pattern_en: The proceeds from your investment sale have settled in the cash account\. The sale order is complete
T34_investment_sale_settled.pattern_id: Hasil penjualan investasi Anda sudah masuk ke rekening tunai\. Perintah penjualan sudah selesai
T34_investment_sale_settled.gist: Investment sale proceeds already settled as cash; no more pending.

T35_scam_prize_fee.pattern_en: You.ve been selected for a cash prize\. Pay the release charge today
T35_scam_prize_fee.pattern_id: Anda terpilih untuk menerima hadiah uang tunai\. Bayar biaya pencairan hari ini
